comparison.objective: Remove the internal burr from a cut copper tube without excessive chamfering.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a tube, coaxially seat a hand reamer, rotate it through controlled passes, and stop before overcutting.
comparison.success_condition: All bore sectors deburred, rim not over-chamfered, tube racked, reamer removed and released; drops and damage limit or erase credit.
comparison.reason: Rotary material removal with damage control does not test selective particle passage through a screen.
